### Layer 3: Procrastinate end-to-end test

This test actually enqueues a job into the procrastinate_jobs table and runs the worker in-process to execute it.

```python
@pytest.mark.real_jobs
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_procrastinate_worker_executes_job_end_to_end(pg_override_db):
    """
    Full e2e: enqueue extract_topics via procrastinate, run worker in-process,
    verify DB state after execution. Proves schema DDL and worker wiring are correct.
    """
    import asyncio
    import contextlib
    import os
    from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch

    Session = pg_override_db
    
    # Set up real DB data
    db = Session()
    user = User(email="e2e@test.com", display_name="E2E")
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    course = Course(name="E2E", slug="e2e-course", user_id=user.id)
    db.add(course)
    db.commit()
    from app.models import Unit, Material
    unit = Unit(name="E2E Unit", course_id=course.id)
    db.add(unit)
    db.commit()
    material = Material(unit_id=unit.id, filename="e2e.pdf", extracted_text="Quantum entanglement basics")
    db.add(material)
    db.commit()
    unit_id = unit.id
    course_id = course.id
    db.close()

    # Temporarily disable TESTING so procrastinate connector opens
    os.environ.pop("TESTING", None)
    try:
        from app.worker import procrastinate_app, extract_topics_task

        with patch("app.services.ai.generate_unit_summary", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value="Test summary"), \
             patch("app.services.ai.extract_topics_from_text", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=[{"name": "Quantum", "children": []}]), \
             patch("app.worker.pregenerate_bank_task.defer_async", new_callable=AsyncMock), \
             patch("app.worker.pregenerate_flashcards_task.defer_async", new_callable=AsyncMock):

            async with procrastinate_app.open_async():
                # Enqueue the real job into procrastinate_jobs table
                await extract_topics_task.defer_async(
                    unit_id=unit_id,
                    course_id=course_id,
                    user_id=None,
                )

                # Run worker as concurrent task, poll for completion
                worker = procrastinate_app.create_worker(queues=["ai"])
                worker_task = asyncio.create_task(
                    worker.run(install_signal_handlers=False)
                )
                try:
                    deadline = asyncio.get_event_loop().time() + 30
                    db = Session()
                    while asyncio.get_event_loop().time() < deadline:
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                        db.expire_all()
                        u = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
                        if u and u.extraction_status in ("done", "failed"):
                            break
                    final_status = db.get(Unit, unit_id).extraction_status
                    db.close()
                finally:
                    worker_task.cancel()
                    with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                        await worker_task
    finally:
        os.environ["TESTING"] = "1"

    assert final_status == "done", f"Expected 'done', got '{final_status}'"
    
    # Verify topics were actually saved
    db = Session()
    from app.models import Topic, UnitTopic
    topics = db.query(Topic).join(UnitTopic).filter(UnitTopic.unit_id == unit_id).all()
    db.close()
    assert len(topics) > 0, "No topics saved after worker executed job"
```

                unit_id=unit_id,
                course_id=course_id,
                user_id=None,

            # Run worker as a concurrent task; poll for completion up to 30 seconds
            worker = procrastinate_app.create_worker(queues=["ai"])
            worker_task = asyncio.create_task(
                worker.run(install_signal_handlers=False)
            )
            try:
                deadline = asyncio.get_event_loop().time() + 30
                db = Session()
                final_status = None
                while asyncio.get_event_loop().time() < deadline:
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                    db.expire_all()
                    u = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
                    if u and u.extraction_status in ("done", "failed"):
                        final_status = u.extraction_status
                        break
                if final_status is None:
                    final_status = (db.get(Unit, unit_id) or Unit()).extraction_status
                db.close()
            finally:
                worker_task.cancel()
                with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                    await worker_task

    topics = (
        db.query(Topic)
        .join(UnitTopic)
        .filter(UnitTopic.unit_id == unit_id)
        .all()
    )
    db.close()
    assert len(topics) > 0, "No topics saved after worker executed job"
